content: Autostart scheme verified locally + ibus/ibus#2910: on Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME ibus-daemon runs via systemd user unit org.freedesktop.IBus.session.GNOME.service (Type=dbus, BusName=org.freedesktop.IBus). A custom engine unit should be After=graphical-session.target and after the IBus unit, with Restart=always. Known failure: ibus-daemon restart loses component registrations AND global engine reverts to default (1.5.29, issue closed as not planned) - goswitchd must watch for IBus connection loss (NameOwnerChanged / socket file replacement) and re-register + re-activate, with a poll-until-ready loop (~2s interval) after daemon restart.
